notes.title: Demo Update ver.0.3
notes.content:
If the title screen shows “ver.0.3” in the bottom right corner, you are running the latest version as of September 13, 2025.

This update includes the following changes compared to previous versions:

(Some dialogue has been adjusted to reflect system changes, but there are no major scenario additions or modifications.)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45306062/e83e11ad86b427c7c866cdaabd7aca0c46f7bce1.png"]
[olist]
Updated Character Portraits for “Jasper” and “Garnet”
The character illustrations have been refreshed to better convey vivid expressions and emotions.

New Gameplay System: “Resonance Value”
Based on the core concept of “Instant Memory Action,” we’ve introduced a new system called Resonance Value.
Destroying traps now grants buffs, making trap-breaking an integral part of combat and adding new layers of strategy to the action.

Other Visual Updates & Bug Fixes
Various UI and effect improvements, along with minor bug fixes.
[/olist]
We continue to work hard to deliver the best possible experience in the full release.
Thank you for your patience, and please look forward to the launch of the full version.

For bug reports, please use the feedback form available at the bottom of the official website:


https://yontacr.wixsite.com/charoite

notes.title: Demo Update ver.0.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45306062/dbf2fb882a86f52dec35f6b9ae0c1c78c1c9920d.png
Update Notes (ver.0.2) – May 10, 2025

Thank you to everyone who played the demo and shared your valuable feedback. Based on your input, we’ve made several adjustments to improve both gameplay enjoyment and overall playability.

If you see “ver.0.2” displayed in the bottom right of the title screen, your game is updated to the latest version as of May 10, 2025.

Compared to previous versions, this update includes the following changes:
(While some dialogue has been adjusted to match gameplay changes, there are no major updates or additions to the story.)

① Action Improvements

Input buffering has been added, allowing you to input the next action during ongoing animations for smoother and more responsive control.

The speed of certain animations has been adjusted, making previously difficult-to-use actions more viable and expanding strategic options.

② Gameplay Concept Enhancements

To reinforce the game’s core concept of “instant memory action,” we’ve revised the behavior when destroying traps.

MP recovery methods have been expanded, making it easier to use dowsing and enabling players to enjoy the “memory → action” loop more frequently.

Stat boosts from the enhancement item “Fragments” have been adjusted, allowing for more flexible and varied build strategies.

③ Item Drop System Adjustments

The benefits of defeating enemies have been enhanced, making the action gameplay more rewarding.

The method for collecting dropped items has been updated to further emphasize the importance of “instant memory action.”

④ Additional Quality of Life Improvements and Bug Fixes

Improved Visibility During Dowsing
We’ve adjusted rendering to ensure hidden areas behind golems or terrain objects (like rocks) are now visible while using the Dowsing skill.

Retry Behavior Update
When choosing “Return to upper floor” after reaching 0 HP, you can now skip directly to the last floor you reached.

Toggle Input Wait on Loading Screens
Previously, loading screens waited for button input to let players read tips. This can now be toggled On/Off in the options menu.

We’re continuing development with the goal of delivering the best possible experience in the full release.
Additionally, a bug report form is available through the official website. For details, please check the "Bug Report" section at the bottom of the site:
https://yontacr.wixsite.com/charoite
